basic_details.job_title: IIT (BHU) Project Research Scientist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) Varanasi (IIT (BHU)) has notified 1 project-based Project Research Scientist-1 (Non-medical) vacancy under advertisement number RISE/SA/ICMR/BME/26-27/921. The position is purely temporary, with an initial tenure of 1 year that is extendable based on performance, and offers a pay of Rs. 56,000 + 20% HRA p.m. as per ICMR norms. Candidates applying for the post must hold a Master’s degree in Biotechnology/Microbiology/Life Science/ Biomedical Engineering or other relevant fields. qualification.details: Master’s degree (MSc/MTech) in Biotechnology/Microbiology/Life Science/ Biomedical Engineering, or other relevant fields of Science/Engineering and associated fields from a recognized University/Institute.

how_to_apply: Prepare an application on plain paper providing your name, permanent and correspondence address, names of father and mother, telephone number, and e-mail address.
Include detailed information regarding your educational career starting from High School or equivalent.
Attach self-attested copies of all mark-sheets and certificates, along with details of any research or other experience.
Send a scanned copy of the signed application by email to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Sudip Mukherjee, at [email protected].
Ensure the application reaches the Principal Investigator on or before 05.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: IIT (BHU) Project Research Scientist-1 (Non-medical) at a Glance

rows.details: Synthesis and screening of novel class of metabolites-based triazole analogues for the treatment of hepatic fibrosis
1 year, extendable based on performance (sanctioned up to 3 years)
No TA/DA will be paid if called for an interview; application fee not mentioned

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential educational qualifications specified for the post. Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates as per GoI rules, all things being equal. Master’s degree (MSc/MTech) in Biotechnology/Microbiology/Life Science/ Biomedical Engineering, or other relevant fields of Science/Engineering and associated fields from a recognized University/Institute. Candidates are preferred with experience in biological assays, molecular biology and evaluation of bioactive compounds. Experience in cell culture, animal handling and experimentation, disease models, histopathological analysis or other techniques for biological/therapeutic evaluation is desirable. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a fixed stipend/fellowship amount of Rs. 56,000 + 20% HRA p.m. as per ICMR norms. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, sanctioned for an initial duration of 1 year and extendable based on performance up to a total tenure of 3 years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (BHU) Project Research Scientist-1 (Non-medical)
content_sections.text: Prepare an application on plain paper providing your name, permanent and correspondence address, names of father and mother, telephone number, and e-mail address. Include detailed information regarding your educational career starting from High School or equivalent. Attach self-attested copies of all mark-sheets and certificates, along with details of any research or other experience. Send a scanned copy of the signed application by email to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Sudip Mukherjee, at [email protected] . Ensure the application reaches the Principal Investigator on or before 05.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The Principal Investigator has the discretion to restrict the number of candidates to be called for interview to a reasonable limit based on qualifications and experience higher than the minimum prescribed. Only shortlisted candidates will be communicated to appear for the interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Project Research Scientist-1 post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, sanctioned for 1 year and extendable based on performance up to 3 years.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances paid in addition to the base stipend?
faq.answer: Yes, the position offers Rs. 56,000 + 20% HRA p.m. as per ICMR norms.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years, with relaxations for SC/ST/Physically Handicapped/Female candidates applicable as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: The Principal Investigator has the discretion to restrict the number of candidates called for the interview to a reasonable limit based on qualifications and experience higher than the minimum prescribed.

faq.question: Q5. What documents must be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must submit an application on plain paper detailing personal info, parent names, contact details, educational career starting from High School, and research experience, along with self-attested copies of all mark-sheets and certificates.
